description: This PHP class defines a decorator for the WorkShift entity in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to format start and end times of work shifts for display or further processing, leveraging helper traits for date-time formatting.

classes.name: WorkShiftDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds presentation-specific functions to the WorkShift entity, mainly for formatting start and end times using helper traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a WorkShift entity.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted start time of the work shift as a string or null.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted end time of the work shift as a string or null.
